moral_or_theme: Trying new things can be fun — you'll never know until you try.

characters.visual_description: small reddish-brown squirrel, big fluffy tail with a cream stripe, round brown eyes, tiny leaf-green scarf tied around his neck
characters.personality: curious but a little cautious about new things; becomes brave once encouraged

characters.visual_description: white bunny with one floppy ear tipped pink, a sky-blue bow on the other ear, big friendly smile

scenes.setting: sunny forest clearing, a big oak tree, a tidy little pile of nuts, soft morning light
scenes.action: Kiko sits by his pile of nuts, munching happily and patting his round tummy.

dialogue.line_en: Yummy nuts for breakfast, yummy nuts for lunch! Nuts, nuts, nuts — that's all I munch!
dialogue.line_te: అల్పాహారానికి రుచికరమైన గింజలు, భోజనానికి కూడా గింజలే! గింజలు, గింజలు, గింజలే నేను తినేది!

scenes.sound_music_notes: light playful ukulele, birds chirping, cheerful morning tone

scenes.action: Bibbo hops in holding a shiny red berry on a leaf and offers it to Kiko, who leans back and puffs up his tail nervously.

dialogue.line_en: Kiko, look! A juicy red berry! Want to try it?
dialogue.line_te: కికో, చూడు! రసవంతమైన ఎర్రటి బెర్రీ! రుచి చూస్తావా?

dialogue.line_en: A berry? No, no! What if I don't like it?

scenes.sound_music_notes: music softens slightly, a light comic 'uh-oh' sting on Kiko's line

scenes.action: Bibbo smiles and holds the berry a little closer; Kiko shuffles backward and wraps his big tail around himself like a blanket.

dialogue.line_en: You'll never know... until you try!
New food is scary. I like my same old nuts.
dialogue.line_te: కొత్త తిండి భయంగా ఉంటుంది. నాకు నా పాత గింజలే ఇష్టం.

scenes.sound_music_notes: gentle, patient musical phrase, nothing tense or scary

scenes.action: Bibbo takes a big happy bite of the berry, twirls with delight, and does a little happy dance.

dialogue.line_en: Mmm! Sweet and juicy! I love it!
dialogue.line_te: మ్మ్! తీపి, రసంగా ఉంది! నాకు చాలా నచ్చింది!

scenes.sound_music_notes: playful sparkle sound effect, bouncy upbeat music

scenes.action: Kiko peeks out from behind his tail and leans forward, nose twitching as he sniffs the berry from a distance.
Kiko squeezes his eyes shut tight and takes one tiny, brave nibble of the berry. His eyes pop wide open with surprise.

dialogue.line_en: Wow! It's sweet! It's yummy! I LIKE it!
dialogue.line_te: వావ్! ఇది తీపిగా ఉంది! చాలా బాగుంది! నాకు నచ్చింది!

scenes.sound_music_notes: big joyful musical swell, cheerful chime

scenes.action: Kiko and Bibbo hop and twirl together, laughing happily, little berry-juice sparkles around them.

dialogue.line_en: You'll never know... until you try!

scenes.sound_music_notes: full bouncy celebration music, both characters laughing

scenes.setting: same forest clearing, the next morning
scenes.action: Kiko spots a small round orange mushroom cap and walks toward it confidently — no hesitation this time — while Bibbo cheers beside him.

dialogue.line_en: New food? Let's try it! You'll never know until you try!
dialogue.line_te: కొత్త తిండా? ప్రయత్నిద్దాం పద! ప్రయత్నించే వరకూ తెలియదు కదా!

scenes.sound_music_notes: confident, upbeat marching-style tune, light and fun

scenes.setting: same forest clearing, golden afternoon light
scenes.action: Kiko and Bibbo sit together with a colorful little spread of nuts, berries, and mushrooms, smiling out at the viewer.
scenes.on_screen_text_en: Trying new things can be fun!
scenes.sound_music_notes: warm closing musical theme, soft fade out

compliance.notes: All content-level checklist items are satisfied: original characters/names/designs (Kiko and Bibbo are invented, not based on any existing IP), tone stays mild and consequence-free (Kiko's hesitation is framed as ordinary shyness, never scary imagery or real danger), no violence, no romance, no substances, no bullying, no off-platform CTAs, no brand mentions, no data-collection prompts, made_for_kids is set true, and the moral is stated explicitly and lands identically in both language tracks. One item cannot be fully closed from the script alone: the sound_music_notes describe mood/instrumentation only (e.g. 'playful ukulele') — no specific track has been sourced yet, so at production time the chosen music must be confirmed original or royalty-free (or licensed) before use, per checklist section 3.

metadata.title_en: Kiko the Squirrel Tries Something New
metadata.description_en: Kiko the squirrel only ever eats nuts — until his brave bunny friend Bibbo shows him that trying new foods can be fun! A gentle, encouraging story for little ones about facing the unknown, one small nibble at a time.
metadata.description_te: కికో ఉడత ఎప్పుడూ గింజలే తింటుంది — కానీ ధైర్యవంతురాలైన స్నేహితురాలు బిబ్బో కుందేలు కొత్త ఆహారాలు ప్రయత్నించడం సరదాగా ఉంటుందని చూపిస్తుంది! కొత్త విషయాలను ఎదుర్కోవడం గురించి చిన్నారుల కోసం ఒక సున్నితమైన, ప్రోత్సాహకరమైన కథ.
metadata.thumbnail_concept: Kiko the squirrel wide-eyed and curious, sniffing a bright red berry held out by Bibbo the bunny; both smiling; sunny forest background; no text clutter
